Save from Apps collection vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Save to Photos support in the binary covers storefront language. Share sheet callbacks and Photos album organization actually separate in-app save behavior from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Save from Apps — the system album where images and videos saved from other apps land when buyers tap Save to Photos, Save Image, or Add to Photos in Safari, Messages, social apps, or third-party apps. Controls on-device organization — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Save to Photos from Safari & Messages — user-facing flows where buyers long-press or share a photo and choose Save to Photos. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building share-extension or save callbacks is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Save from social & third-party apps — images exported from Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, or other apps that appear in Save from Apps. Listing copy may mention cross-app saving; implementing export or save UI is in-app engineering.
  • Browse saved images and videos — buyers open the Save from Apps album to review everything saved from other apps instead of scrolling Recents. Listing copy names that path; building album-grid UI is engineering.
  • Share sheet & UIActivityViewController — system share flows that offer Save to Photos as a destination. Listing copy covers screenshot caption lines — not UIActivityViewController or share-extension implementation.
  • Shared with You (different feature) — Messages-originated content surfacing in Photos For You shelves — not the same as the Save from Apps album grid. Mention only as contrast; do not paste 与你共享 copy onto Save from Apps hero frames.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Save from Apps support in the binary.

An app that saves or browses Save from Apps content and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. FAQ

Does shipping Save to Photos auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Save from Apps album collection, Share sheet Save to Photos callbacks, and cross-app save flows control runtime library behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Save from Apps, Save to Photos, saved from other apps, 从 App 存储, 从其他 App 存储到照片, and 从 App 保存 — rewritten from your English originals.

Does AppLocale implement Share sheet or Save to Photos APIs?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. UIActivityViewController, share extensions, and PhotoKit save engineering are outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from Shared with You, Imports, and photo library hub pages?

Save from Apps listing copy covers Photos → Albums → Save from Apps — images and videos saved from other apps collected in the Save from Apps album. Shared with You is Messages-originated For You shelves — see Shared with You listing (zh-Hans). Imports is camera and SD card transfer — see Imports listing (zh-Hans). Apple Photos photo-library listing copy covers general albums and iCloud Photos browsing. Shared Albums listing copy covers collaborative album invitations. Each surface has a separate guide.

Why do my Save from Apps screenshot captions still say Save from Apps in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 从 App 存储, 从其他 App 存储到照片, or 从 App 保存 value.

Should zh-Hans copy use 从 App 存储 or 从其他 App 存储到照片?

从 App 存储 matches Apple's Simplified Chinese label for the Save from Apps album. 从其他 App 存储到照片 fits frames that explain cross-app saving into Photos. 从 App 保存 fits shorter subtitle or keyword rows. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English claims and screenshot frames.
